text: Applicants must have three years of Python experience.
A bachelor's degree in computer science is required.
AWS certification is preferred but not required.
Nice to have: experience with Kubernetes.
Bonus points for prior work in financial services.
You will review code and maintain automated tests.
Responsibilities include supporting customers and documenting releases.
In this role, design and build accessible web interfaces.
This position is hybrid, with two days per week in the Austin office.
Travel is required up to 20 percent of working time.
